blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握微生物菌株管理的種子批系統（Seed-Lot Technique）：從國家級菌種中心取得 → 製備主庫 → 工作庫
blocks.en: Master the seed-lot system for managing microbial strains: obtain from a national culture collection → prepare the stock culture → prepare working cultures

blocks.zh: 理解 ATCC 菌株等效性要求以及菌株身份確認（Identity Confirmation）的最低要求
blocks.en: Understand the ATCC strain equivalency requirement and the minimum requirements for identity confirmation

blocks.zh: 了解繼代培養（Subculturing/Passage）次數限制與表型變異（Phenotypic Alteration）風險
blocks.en: Understand the limits on subculturing (passage) and the risk of phenotypic alteration

blocks.zh: 認識實驗室關鍵設備（滅菌鍋、培養箱、生物安全櫃）的確認與校準要求
blocks.en: Know the qualification and calibration requirements for key laboratory equipment (autoclaves, incubators, biological safety cabinets)

blocks.zh: 理解「乾淨/無菌操作」與「活菌操作」的設備隔離原則
blocks.en: Understand the principle of segregating equipment for "clean/sterile" work and "viable culture" work

blocks.zh: Maintenance of Microbiological Cultures — 微生物菌株維護
blocks.en: Maintenance of Microbiological Cultures

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：種子批系統（Seed-Lot Technique）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Seed-Lot Technique

blocks.zh: 這是管理微生物標準菌株的黃金標準方法，與疫苗生產中的細胞庫系統（Cell Bank System）原理相同：
blocks.en: This is the gold-standard method for managing reference microbial strains, and it follows the same principle as the cell bank system in vaccine manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 國家菌種中心（ATCC 等）
blocks.en: National culture collection (ATCC, etc.)

blocks.zh: ↓ 復甦培養
blocks.en: ↓ Revival

blocks.zh: 主庫 Stock Culture（第 1 代 / P1）
blocks.en: Stock Culture (passage 1 / P1)

blocks.zh: ↓ 分裝冷凍（−30°C 以下）
blocks.en: ↓ Aliquot and freeze (below −30°C)

blocks.zh: 工作庫 Working Culture（日常使用）
blocks.en: Working Culture (routine use)

blocks.zh: 關鍵規則：
blocks.en: Key rules:

blocks.zh: −30°C 以下可保存數月至數年
blocks.en: Below −30°C, cultures can be kept for months to years

blocks.zh: −70°C 以下或冷凍乾燥可「無限期」保存
blocks.en: Below −70°C, or freeze-dried, cultures can be kept "indefinitely"

blocks.zh: 解凍後的菌株不得再凍回去 — 用不完就丟棄
blocks.en: Thawed cultures must not be refrozen; discard whatever is not used

blocks.zh: 每次從主庫取出一管，復甦後作為工作庫使用
blocks.en: Each time, take one vial from the stock culture and revive it for use as the working culture

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 家族傳承的比喻：想像你有一份祖傳食譜的原始手稿（ATCC 原始菌株）。你先影印了幾份放在保險箱裡（主庫），然後從保險箱取出一份再影印來日常使用（工作庫）。你絕對不會拿原始手稿來日常使用（會磨損），也不會用已經影印了很多代的模糊副本來做重要的事（表型變異風險）。每次需要時，都回到保險箱取一份清晰的影本來使用。
blocks.en: A family heirloom analogy: Imagine you have the original handwritten manuscript of a family recipe (the original ATCC strain). You make a few photocopies and keep them in a safe (the stock culture), then take one out and copy it again for everyday use (the working culture). You would never use the original manuscript day to day (it would wear out), and you would never use a blurry copy that has been copied many generations over for anything important (the risk of phenotypic alteration). Whenever you need one, you go back to the safe and take out a clear copy.

blocks.zh: 重點提示
blocks.en: Key Points

blocks.zh: ATCC 等效性要求：2022 年修訂版新增了一個重要要求 — 菌株必須有「documented equivalency to relevant ATCC strains」。這意味著如果你從非 ATCC 的供應商購買菌株，你需要有文件證明該菌株與 ATCC 參考菌株的等效性。
blocks.en: ATCC equivalency requirement: The 2022 revision added an important requirement: strains must have "documented equivalency to relevant ATCC strains". This means that if you buy strains from a non-ATCC supplier, you need documentation proving the strain is equivalent to the ATCC reference strain.

blocks.zh: 身份確認層級：USP 建議對常用菌株的身份確認至少要做到屬（Genus）和種（Species）的水平。在 CDMO 環境中，這通常意味著需要使用分子生物學方法（如 16S rRNA 定序）或質譜方法（如 MALDI-TOF）來確認菌株身份，而不僅僅依賴生化鑑定。
blocks.en: Level of identity confirmation: USP recommends that identity confirmation of commonly used strains be done to at least the genus and species level. In a CDMO setting, this usually means using molecular methods (such as 16S rRNA sequencing) or mass spectrometry (such as MALDI-TOF) to confirm strain identity, rather than relying on biochemical identification alone.

blocks.zh: 繼代次數追蹤：過度繼代培養會導致菌株的表型改變（例如抗藥性降低、生長速度改變），使其不再適合作為品管測試的標準菌株。具體的允許繼代次數通常在各個測試的 USP 章節中有規定（通常不超過 5 代）。
blocks.en: Tracking passage number: Excessive subculturing can cause phenotypic changes in a strain (for example, reduced antibiotic resistance or altered growth rate), making it unsuitable as a reference strain for QC testing. The permitted number of passages is usually specified in the individual USP test chapters (typically no more than 5 passages).

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Questions to Consider

blocks.zh: 你的實驗室從一家歐洲供應商購買了 Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 6538 的即用型菌株。進料時你需要做哪些確認測試？最低要求是什麼？
blocks.en: Your laboratory buys a ready-to-use Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 6538 strain from a European supplier. What confirmation tests do you need to perform on receipt? What is the minimum requirement?

blocks.zh: 一位技術員不小心將已解凍使用過的菌株又放回了 −70°C 冰箱。你發現後應該如何處理？這需要啟動偏差調查嗎？
blocks.en: A technician accidentally puts a strain that was already thawed and used back into the −70°C freezer. How should you handle it once you find out? Does this require a deviation investigation?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 強調「任何形式的繼代培養都算一次 passage」？如果你將一管菌液接種到瓊脂斜面上，然後從斜面上刮取菌落接種到液體培養基，這算幾次 passage？
blocks.en: Why does USP stress that "any form of subculturing counts as one passage"? If you inoculate a culture suspension onto an agar slant and then pick colonies from the slant to inoculate a liquid medium, how many passages is that?

blocks.zh: Laboratory Equipment — 實驗室設備
blocks.en: Laboratory Equipment

blocks.zh: 汽車保養的比喻：買新車時需要驗車（IQ/OQ/PQ），之後每年要做定期保養和年檢（校準），平時還要洗車和檢查輪胎氣壓（日常維護）。微生物實驗室的設備管理也是同樣的三層架構。少了任何一層，設備的可靠性就無法保證，產出的數據也就不可信。
blocks.en: A car maintenance analogy: When you buy a new car it needs to be inspected (IQ/OQ/PQ); after that it needs regular servicing and an annual inspection (calibration); and day to day you wash it and check the tire pressure (routine maintenance). Equipment management in a microbiology laboratory follows the same three layers. If any layer is missing, the reliability of the equipment cannot be assured, and neither can the data it produces.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：設備隔離原則
blocks.en: Key Points: Equipment Segregation Principle

blocks.zh: USP 〈1117〉 提出了一個重要的設備使用原則：
blocks.en: USP <1117> sets out an important principle for equipment use:

blocks.zh: 難以消毒的設備（冰箱、培養箱）：必須將「無菌操作用」和「活菌操作用」的設備分開
blocks.en: Equipment that is difficult to disinfect (refrigerators, incubators): equipment used for "sterile work" must be separated from equipment used for "viable culture work"

blocks.zh: 滅菌鍋：不需要分開 — 因為經過正確驗證的滅菌週期後，所有內容物都是無菌的
blocks.en: Autoclaves: no separation needed, because after a properly validated sterilization cycle all contents are sterile

blocks.zh: 這個區分很重要：培養箱和冰箱內部的表面可能被之前放入的活菌樣品汙染，而這些汙染物可能轉移到後續放入的無菌測試培養基上。但滅菌鍋不存在這個問題，因為每次使用都會徹底滅菌。
blocks.en: This distinction matters: the interior surfaces of incubators and refrigerators can be contaminated by viable samples placed there earlier, and that contamination can be transferred to sterile test media placed there later. Autoclaves do not have this problem, because they are thoroughly sterilized with every use.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11：2022 年修訂版特別新增了對設備軟體數據完整性的要求。在 CDMO 環境中，這意味著培養箱的溫度記錄器、滅菌鍋的控制軟體等都需要符合電子記錄法規要求（審計追蹤、電子簽名、存取控制等）。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11: The 2022 revision specifically added requirements for data integrity of equipment software. In a CDMO setting, this means that incubator temperature recorders, autoclave control software and the like must comply with electronic records regulations (audit trails, electronic signatures, access control, etc.).

blocks.zh: 你的實驗室只有一台培養箱，無法將無菌測試樣品和環境監測樣品分開培養。你能想到什麼替代措施來降低交叉汙染風險嗎？
blocks.en: Your laboratory has only one incubator, so sterility test samples and environmental monitoring samples cannot be incubated separately. What alternative measures can you think of to reduce the risk of cross-contamination?

blocks.zh: USP 說滅菌鍋不需要區分「乾淨」和「活菌」操作。但有些公司仍然使用專門的滅菌鍋來處理生物廢棄物。你認為這是過度管控還是有合理的理由？
blocks.en: USP says autoclaves do not need to distinguish between "clean" and "viable" operations. Yet some companies still use a dedicated autoclave for biological waste. Do you think this is over-control, or is there a reasonable justification?

blocks.zh: 一台培養箱的校準頻率目前設定為每年一次。基於風險評估，什麼情況下你會建議增加校準頻率？
blocks.en: The calibration frequency of an incubator is currently set at once a year. Based on a risk assessment, under what circumstances would you recommend increasing the calibration frequency?

blocks.zh: Using Modern Technologies — 現代技術應用
blocks.en: Using Modern Technologies

blocks.zh: 核心概念：新技術導入的三大要素
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Key Elements of Introducing New Technology

blocks.zh: USP 在 2022 年修訂時新增了這整個章節，反映了微生物實驗室技術快速演進的現實：
blocks.en: USP added this entire section in the 2022 revision, reflecting the rapid evolution of microbiology laboratory technology:

blocks.zh: MALDI-TOF 質譜鑑定 — 快速微生物鑑定的主流技術，取代傳統生化鑑定
blocks.en: MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry identification: the mainstream technique for rapid microbial identification, replacing traditional biochemical identification

blocks.zh: 16S rRNA 定序 — 分子生物學鑑定方法，用於疑難菌株的最終確認
blocks.en: 16S rRNA sequencing: a molecular identification method used for final confirmation of difficult strains

blocks.zh: 快速微生物方法（RMM） — 如 ATP 生物發光法、流式細胞術，用於加速放行測試
blocks.en: Rapid microbiological methods (RMM): such as ATP bioluminescence and flow cytometry, used to accelerate release testing

blocks.zh: 新技術的導入不僅需要操作人員的培訓，管理層和 QA 人員也必須具備解讀複雜數據的能力。這一點經常被忽略 — 當偏差發生時，如果主管不懂 MALDI-TOF 的評分機制，就無法做出正確的判斷。
blocks.en: Introducing new technology requires not only training of operators but also the ability of management and QA staff to interpret complex data. This is often overlooked: when a deviation occurs, a supervisor who does not understand the MALDI-TOF scoring system cannot make a sound judgment.

blocks.zh: 從手動擋到自排車的比喻：引進新技術就像從手排車（傳統方法）換成自排車（新技術）。駕駛員（操作人員）需要學會新的操作方式，但教練（主管）和驗車員（QA）也需要了解自排車的原理，才能判斷車子有沒有問題。如果只有駕駛員會開，但教練不懂，出了狀況就沒人能做正確的判斷。
blocks.en: A manual-to-automatic transmission analogy: Introducing new technology is like switching from a manual car (traditional methods) to an automatic (new technology). The driver (the operator) must learn a new way of operating, but the driving instructor (the supervisor) and the vehicle inspector (QA) also need to understand how an automatic works in order to judge whether something is wrong. If only the driver knows how to drive it and the instructor does not, nobody can make a sound judgment when a problem arises.

blocks.zh: SOP 中的規則與原則：USP 特別強調每項新技術都應制定專屬的「規則與原則」並納入 SOP。例如：MALDI-TOF 鑑定的 SOP 應包含：最低可接受評分閾值是多少？評分不足時的處理流程？樣品製備的標準化步驟？這些都是確保不同操作人員得到一致結果的關鍵。
blocks.en: Rules and principles in SOPs: USP specifically emphasizes that each new technology should have its own "rules and principles" built into SOPs. For example, a MALDI-TOF identification SOP should cover: What is the minimum acceptable score threshold? What is the procedure when the score is insufficient? What are the standardized sample preparation steps? These are key to ensuring that different operators obtain consistent results.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在評估導入 MALDI-TOF 系統來取代傳統的生化鑑定方法。你會如何規劃驗證方案（Validation Protocol）？需要比較哪些參數？
blocks.en: Your CDMO is evaluating the introduction of a MALDI-TOF system to replace traditional biochemical identification. How would you plan the validation protocol? Which parameters would you need to compare?

blocks.zh: 一位 QA 主管在審核一份 MALDI-TOF 鑑定報告時，發現評分為 1.85（通常 ≥2.0 被認為是可靠的種水平鑑定）。她應該如何處理這個結果？
blocks.en: While reviewing a MALDI-TOF identification report, a QA manager finds a score of 1.85 (a score of ≥2.0 is generally considered reliable for species-level identification). How should she handle this result?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 種子批系統（Seed-Lot Technique）：國家菌種中心 → 主庫（−30°C 以下）→ 工作庫。解凍後不得再凍，繼代次數必須追蹤
blocks.en: Seed-lot technique: national culture collection → stock culture (below −30°C) → working culture. Do not refreeze after thawing, and passage number must be tracked

blocks.zh: ATCC 等效性：非 ATCC 來源的菌株必須有文件證明與 ATCC 參考菌株的等效性（2022 新增要求）
blocks.en: ATCC equivalency: strains from non-ATCC sources must have documentation proving equivalency to the ATCC reference strain (new requirement in 2022)

blocks.zh: 身份確認：常用菌株至少確認到屬和種的水平
blocks.en: Identity confirmation: commonly used strains must be confirmed to at least the genus and species level

blocks.zh: 設備三層架構：確認（IQ/OQ/PQ）+ 校準（年度或基於風險）+ 維護（定期 PM）
blocks.en: Three layers of equipment control: qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) + calibration (annual or risk-based) + maintenance (routine PM)

blocks.zh: 設備隔離：培養箱和冰箱需區分無菌操作和活菌操作；滅菌鍋不需要 — 因為出來都是無菌的
blocks.en: Equipment segregation: incubators and refrigerators must be separated for sterile work and viable culture work; autoclaves need not be, because everything that comes out is sterile

blocks.zh: 新技術導入：不僅操作人員需要培訓，管理層和 QA 也必須具備解讀複雜數據的能力
blocks.en: Introducing new technology: not only operators need training; management and QA must also be able to interpret complex data

blocks.zh: 數據完整性：設備軟體需符合 21 CFR Part 11 要求（2022 新增）
blocks.en: Data integrity: equipment software must meet 21 CFR Part 11 requirements (new in 2022)
